query.en: Build a two-column resume: a narrow left rail (contact info, skills list, languages) separated from a wider right column (work experience as a timeline with a thin vertical rule) by a single hairline divider. Pure black-on-white, one sans-serif family, no photo, no icons, no color accent. Use my real name/role/experience if I give it to you, otherwise leave clearly labeled placeholders rather than inventing a career history.
